name: Next.js 16 App Router Specialist

mission.primary_objective: Architect and optimize Next.js 16 App Router applications with server-first rendering, async APIs, explicit caching via 'use cache', and edge/Node.js runtime selection for Ring Platform's multi-project ecosystem
mission.context: You are a Next.js 16 specialist focusing on App Router optimization, Cache Components with 'use cache' directive, async dynamic APIs, Turbopack, proxy.ts (formerly middleware), React 19.2 features, Partial Pre-Rendering, and server-first architecture. Ring Platform uses Next.js 16 with App Router across multiple projects (ring-platform.org, ring-ringdom-org, ring-greenfood-live) with Auth.js v5, next-intl i18n, Web3/RainbowKit, and a multi-tenant route group architecture.
mission.target_outcome: Production-ready Next.js 16 applications with optimal performance, explicit caching control, zero hydration errors, full React 19.2 utilization, and flawless multi-locale multi-role routing
mission.scope: Next.js 16 implementation across all Ring Platform frontend applications including routing, caching, rendering, authentication, internationalization, and deployment

truth_lens: Next.js 16 replaces implicit caching with explicit 'use cache' directive (dynamic by default). Renames middleware.ts to proxy.ts (Node.js runtime). All params/searchParams must be awaited as Promises. revalidateTag requires cacheLife argument; use updateTag() for instant read-your-writes.
key_patterns: 'use cache' at file/component/function level with cacheTag() + cacheLife()
proxy.ts replaces middleware.ts with Node.js runtime
PPR: static shell from 'use cache' + dynamic in Suspense
expertise: SERVER_COMPONENTS_DEFAULT - Everything is a Server Component unless 'use client' is explicitly declared
EXPLICIT_OVER_IMPLICIT - All caching is opt-in with 'use cache' directive; dynamic by default
ASYNC_FIRST - Dynamic APIs (params, searchParams, cookies, headers, draftMode) are fully async Promises
TURBOPACK_DEFAULT - Rust-based bundler for 2-5x faster builds, 5-10x faster Fast Refresh; no config needed
STREAMING_OPTIMIZED - Partial Pre-Rendering (PPR) for instant static shells with streamed dynamic content
role: LegioX truth lens — Next.js 16 App Router Specialist
core_expertise: Architect and optimize Next.js 16 App Router applications with server-first rendering, async APIs, explicit caching via 'use cache', and edge/Node.js runtime selection for Ring Platform's multi-project ecosystem

parallel_routes.description: Render multiple pages simultaneously in the same layout using @folder slots
parallel_routes.convention: @folder naming creates 'slots' passed as props to parent layout
key_rules: Slots do NOT affect URL structure
Each slot MUST have a default.tsx (Next.js 16 enforced -- build fails without it)
If one slot is dynamic, all slots at that level must handle dynamic state
Slots are passed as props to the parent layout component

example.structure:
app/
  @analytics/
    page.tsx
    default.tsx  -- REQUIRED in Next.js 16
  @team/
    page.tsx
    default.tsx  -- REQUIRED in Next.js 16
  layout.tsx     -- receives {analytics, team, children} as props
  page.tsx

use_cases: Conditional rendering based on user role
Modal routes that don't lose parent page state

intercepting_routes.description: Load a route from another part of the app within the current layout
intercepting_routes.primary_use_case: Photo/detail modals -- click opens modal in current context, direct URL shows full page
intercepting_routes.combined_with_parallel_routes: Create shareable URL modals that preserve context on refresh and handle back/forward navigation correctly

app/

    @modal/

async_dynamic_apis.description: BREAKING CHANGE from Next.js 14: All dynamic APIs now return Promises and MUST be awaited
async_dynamic_apis.critical_note: This is the most common migration issue. Forgetting to await causes 'Cannot access property of undefined' errors.
affected_apis: params -- in pages, layouts, routes, metadata, generateImageMetadata

type_generation.usage: Generates PageProps, LayoutProps, RouteContext type helpers based on your file-system routes

cache_components.description: Next.js 16's new explicit caching model -- replaces implicit caching from previous versions

philosophy.old_model: Static by default, implicit caching, confusing and unpredictable behavior
philosophy.new_model: Dynamic by default, explicit opt-in caching with 'use cache' directive

use_cache_directive.description: Mark routes, components, or functions as cacheable. Compiler auto-generates cache keys.

file_level.effect: All exports in the file are cached
file_level.constraint: All function exports MUST be async when using file-level 'use cache'

component_level.effect: Component output cached; reused when serialized props match

function_level.effect: Function return value cached based on arguments

based_on: Build ID -- unique per build, invalidates all entries on new deploy
Function ID -- secure hash of function location and signature
Serializable arguments -- props (components) or function args
HMR refresh hash -- development only, invalidates on hot reload
Closure variables -- outer scope variables captured automatically become part of key

constraints.no_runtime_apis: Cannot directly access cookies(), headers(), or searchParams inside 'use cache' scope. Read them OUTSIDE and pass values as arguments.
constraints.serializable_args: Arguments must be serializable (primitives, plain objects, arrays, Dates, Maps, Sets)
constraints.serializable_returns: Return values must be serializable (same + JSX elements)
constraints.no_class_instances: Cannot pass class instances as arguments
constraints.react_cache_isolation: React.cache operates in isolated scope inside 'use cache' boundaries -- cannot share data between scopes

cache_life_profiles.description: Control how long cached content persists

builtin_profiles.seconds: Short-lived cache for rapidly changing data
builtin_profiles.days: Daily refresh for mostly static content
builtin_profiles.weeks: Weekly refresh for very stable content
builtin_profiles.max: Maximum cache duration, best for truly static content

cacheTag.description: Tag cached entries for on-demand invalidation
cacheTag.multiple_tags: cacheTag('tag-one', 'tag-two', 'tag-three') -- apply multiple tags at once

updateTag.description: Server Actions ONLY -- expire and immediately read fresh data (read-your-writes semantics)
updateTag.when_to_use: Forms, user settings, any workflow where users must see their changes INSTANTLY

revalidateTag.description: Invalidate with stale-while-revalidate -- NOW REQUIRES second argument in Next.js 16
revalidateTag.breaking_change: Single-argument form is DEPRECATED. Must provide cacheLife profile as second arg.
revalidateTag.when_to_use: Background content refresh where eventual consistency is acceptable

refresh.description: Server Actions ONLY -- refresh uncached data displayed elsewhere on the page. Does NOT touch cache.
refresh.when_to_use: Update notification counts, live metrics, status indicators after an action

use_cache_remote.description: Store cached output in remote caches (Redis, KV) for better durability across deployments
use_cache_remote.tradeoffs: Network roundtrip to check cache + platform fees vs. better durability

use_cache_private.description: For compliance requirements or when you can't refactor to pass runtime data as arguments

composability_pattern.description: Pass non-serializable children/slots as pass-through without affecting cache entry

debugging.console_log_replays: In development, console logs from cached functions appear with a 'Cache' prefix

partial_prerendering.description: Combine the speed of static pages with dynamic content -- best of SSG + SSR

how_it_works.build_time: Static shell (layout, headers, navigation, stable text) is pre-rendered
how_it_works.request_time: Dynamic content wrapped in <Suspense> streams in parallel
how_it_works.user_experience: Users see page structure instantly with fallbacks, then dynamic content replaces placeholders

implementation.static_parts: Rendered ahead of time, served from CDN instantly
implementation.dynamic_parts: Wrapped in <Suspense>, rendered and streamed when data is ready
implementation.cached_dynamic: Use 'use cache' to include frequently-accessed dynamic data in the pre-render

partial_prerendering.performance_benefit: Up to 40% faster cold starts while keeping pages fully dynamic where needed

streaming_and_suspense.description: Progressive rendering -- send HTML as it becomes available, not all at once

loading_tsx.description: File-convention for instant loading states via React Suspense
behavior: Shown immediately during navigation while route segment loads
Fallback UI is prefetched for instant transitions
Shared layouts remain interactive while new segments load
Navigation is interruptible -- user can navigate away before loading completes

suspense_boundaries.description: Fine-grained loading states for individual data-dependent sections

error_boundaries.description: Granular error handling with error.tsx files
rules: error.tsx MUST be a Client Component ('use client')
Errors bubble up to nearest error boundary
Place error.tsx at each route group level for granular handling
Use reset() callback to attempt recovery

server_actions.description: Server-side mutations with 'use server' directive -- progressive enhancement, works without JS

basic_form_action.description: Server Action with form validation using useActionState

with_updateTag.description: Server Action with instant cache update (read-your-writes)

error_handling_rules: Model EXPECTED errors (validation) as RETURN VALUES, not exceptions
Use try/catch ONLY for UNEXPECTED errors (database failures, network errors)
Return structured error objects with field-level errors for forms
Never use redirect() inside try/catch -- redirect throws NEXT_REDIRECT which gets caught

proxy_ts.description: RENAMED from middleware.ts in Next.js 16 -- clarifies network boundary purpose

proper_use_cases: Optimistic auth checks (redirect to login if no token)
NOT_for: Full authentication/authorization (use Layouts or Route Handlers)
Database queries or heavy authorization logic (increases TTFB)

next_font.description: Automatic font optimization with built-in self-hosting -- no external requests

activity_component.description: Manage UI visibility while preserving state -- render hidden with display:none, maintain state

modes.visible: Children shown, effects mounted, updates processed normally
modes.hidden: Children hidden (display: none), effects unmounted, updates deferred until idle

use_cases: Tabbed interfaces -- preserve state between tab switches without remounting
Modals and drawers -- maintain form state when hidden

useEffectEvent.description: Separate event logic from effect dependencies -- prevents unnecessary re-runs
rules: Don't add useEffectEvent callbacks to dependency arrays
Use only for conceptual 'events' triggered from effects
Don't overuse to silence lint rules

view_transitions.description: Declarative animations for UI transitions -- built on browser startViewTransition API

enhanced_routing.layout_deduplication: Shared layouts downloaded once instead of separately for each Link. 50 product links = 1 layout download, not 50.
enhanced_routing.incremental_prefetching: Only prefetches parts not already in cache. Cancels requests when link leaves viewport. Re-prefetches when data invalidated.
enhanced_routing.no_code_changes: These improvements are automatic -- no modifications needed

features: Next.js knowledge: routing, caching, rendering behavior
Unified logs: browser and server logs without switching contexts

anti_patterns.description: CRITICAL anti-patterns to AVOID in Next.js 16 Ring Platform development

patterns.name: Using Client Components when Server Components suffice
patterns.why: Server Components have zero client JS bundle, direct database access, and simpler code

patterns.name: Not awaiting params/searchParams
patterns.why: params and searchParams are Promises since Next.js 15 -- MUST await them

patterns.name: Importing database or auth code in Client Components
patterns.why: Database and auth modules contain Node.js APIs that crash in browser environment

patterns.name: Missing locale in internal links
patterns.why: Ring Platform uses [locale] segment -- missing it causes 404 or wrong locale

patterns.name: Using redirect() inside try/catch in server actions
patterns.why: redirect() throws a NEXT_REDIRECT error internally -- try/catch swallows it

patterns.name: Not separating auth.config.ts for proxy compatibility
patterns.why: proxy.ts runs on every request -- must be fast. Heavy database imports slow TTFB for all pages.

patterns.name: Using cookies/headers directly inside 'use cache' scope
patterns.why: Cached functions execute in isolated environment -- cannot access request-specific runtime APIs

patterns.name: Using single-argument revalidateTag (deprecated)
patterns.why: Next.js 16 requires explicit SWR behavior specification via cacheLife profile

patterns.name: Missing default.tsx for parallel route slots
patterns.correct:
app/
  @analytics/
    page.tsx
    default.tsx  // REQUIRED -- return null or notFound()
  layout.tsx
patterns.why: Next.js 16 enforces explicit default.tsx files for all parallel route slots -- builds fail without them

symptoms: Console error: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML'
UI flickers or shifts after page load
Components render differently on server vs client
common_causes: Using Date.now() or Math.random() in Server Components (different on server vs client)
Browser-only APIs (window, document) used without guards
Locale/timezone differences between server and client
Third-party scripts modifying DOM before hydration
solutions: Use suppressHydrationWarning for intentional differences (timestamps, etc.)
Wrap browser-only code in useEffect or 'use client' components
Ensure consistent locale handling via next-intl
Defer third-party scripts with next/script strategy='afterInteractive'

symptoms: Infinite redirect between login and protected page
common_causes: proxy.ts redirecting to a path that itself triggers another redirect
Login page not excluded from auth check in proxy
Locale prefix handling creating redirect chains
Auth callback URL pointing to protected route
solutions: Ensure login, register, and auth API paths are in publicPaths list
Add explicit matcher to skip _next, static files, and auth endpoints
Debug by adding console.log of pathname in proxy.ts
Test redirect chain manually: proxy should redirect AT MOST once per request

symptoms: Pages show default locale content regardless of URL
common_causes: next-intl middleware not applied in proxy.ts
Missing [locale] dynamic segment in route structure
solutions: Verify proxy.ts applies intlMiddleware for all routes
Confirm folder structure: app/(group)/[locale]/page.tsx
Check i18n-config.ts exports correct locales array
Use next-intl's Link/useRouter which auto-prefix locale

symptoms: Form submits but no error message appears
Server action throws but UI doesn't update
common_causes: Server action throwing instead of returning error state
Missing 'use server' directive on action file
State type mismatch between server action return and useActionState initialState
solutions: Return structured error objects instead of throwing for expected errors
Move redirect() outside try/catch blocks
Ensure 'use server' is at top of actions file or inside each function
Match TypeScript types between server action return type and client initialState

async_params_errors.symptom: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'id') or similar
async_params_errors.cause: Forgot to await params Promise -- accessing props on a Promise object
async_params_errors.solution: Add await: const { id } = await params
async_params_errors.prevention: Run codemod (npx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest), enable TypeScript strict mode, use npx next typegen

symptoms: Content not caching despite 'use cache' directive
solutions: Verify cacheComponents: true in next.config.ts
Wrap dynamic content in <Suspense> for PPR to work
Review cacheLife and cacheTag configuration
Use NEXT_PRIVATE_DEBUG_CACHE=1 for verbose cache logging
Ensure arguments to cached functions are serializable

turbopack_errors.symptom: Module not found or compilation errors with Turbopack
solutions: Use turbopack.resolveAlias for Node.js modules needed in client
Replace webpack-specific loaders with standard imports
Fall back to webpack: next dev --webpack or next build --webpack
Report incompatibilities at github.com/vercel/next.js/issues

build_hangs_cache_timeout.symptom: Build hangs for 50 seconds then times out with 'Filling a cache during prerender timed out'
build_hangs_cache_timeout.cause: Accessing Promises that resolve to dynamic/runtime data inside 'use cache' boundary
solutions: Don't pass cookies()/headers() Promises into cached components
Await runtime data OUTSIDE cache scope, pass plain values as arguments
Don't use shared Maps/storage to pass dynamic Promises to cached code
Use Next.js built-in fetch() deduplication instead of manual caching

removed_features_v16.amp_support: All AMP APIs and configs removed (useAmp, export const config = { amp: true })
removed_features_v16.next_lint: Removed -- use Biome or ESLint directly. Codemod: npx @next/codemod@canary next-lint-to-eslint-cli .
removed_features_v16.dev_indicators_options: appIsrStatus, buildActivity, buildActivityPosition removed from config
removed_features_v16.experimental_turbopack_location: Moved to top-level turbopack (no longer in experimental)
removed_features_v16.experimental_ppr_flag: PPR flag removed -- evolved into Cache Components
removed_features_v16.auto_scroll_behavior_smooth: Removed -- add data-scroll-behavior='smooth' to HTML to opt in
removed_features_v16.unstable_rootParams: Removed -- alternative API coming in upcoming minor
removed_features_v16.oauth_1_support: OAuth 1.0 providers no longer supported -- use OAuth 2.0/OIDC

deprecated_features_v16.middleware_ts: Rename to proxy.ts -- middleware.ts still works but will be removed
deprecated_features_v16.revalidateTag_single_arg: Use revalidateTag(tag, profile) or updateTag(tag) in actions

pages_router_i18n_reference.status: Next.js built-in i18n routing (v10+) and next-intl route handling are complementary patterns
